content.text: No restriction on our business appears anywhere in the agreement — and the licence grant affirmatively preserves our freedom to build or buy alternatives.

input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder, so long as such
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on us, meeting the preferred position. Section 2(a) goes further and expressly confirms we are not obligated to use the licence and remain free to acquire, develop or license competing software and services, subject only to TrueLink's IP rights and our Section 10 confidentiality obligations — both ordinary carve-outs, not business restrictions. The only Client covenants (Section 8) concern legal compliance, access controls, content warranties and anti-spam, and the sole restriction in Section 7 is on spamming; none limits the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. The reference in Section 8(d) to a separate "Non-Competition Agreement" operates as a limitation on TrueLink's use of Credit Data, i.e. in our favour, so it is not flagged; we note only that that separate agreement is not before us and should be reviewed independently. The licence scope wording ("in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables") defines the permitted use of TrueLink's own Interface rather than restricting our activities, so it is not a field-of-use covenant of the kind this rule targets.
